title: 합동참모본부 직제 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Staff Departments)
(1) Staff departments shall be divided into special staff and general staff departments.
(2) Under the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the special staff departments shall comprise the Office of the Chief Secretary, Public Affairs Office, Legal Affairs Office, Combat Readiness Inspection Office, and Analysis and Experimentation Office. <Amended on December 27, 2012; February 16, 2015; June 11, 2019>
(3) The general staff departments shall comprise the Intelligence Headquarters, Operations Headquarters, Strategic Planning Headquarters, and Military Support Headquarters. <Amended on December 30, 2022; August 6, 2024>
